LABEL: alveolar capillary
Definition: A capillary that is part of the alveolar wall and participates in the blood-gas barrier, facilitating gas exchange between the alveolar air space and the blood. Alveolar capillaries form an extensive network around the pulmonary alveoli, where oxygen diffuses from the alveolar air into the blood and carbon dioxide diffuses from the blood into the alveolar air.

LABEL: alveolar mucosa capillary
Definition: A capillary that is part of the alveolar mucosa and contributes to the vascular plexus providing nutrition to the oral mucosa lining between the buccal and labial mucosae.

LABEL: anterior lingual gland capillary
Definition: A capillary that is part of the anterior lingual gland, one of the smallest blood vessels connecting arterioles to venules within the mucous glands located near the apex of the tongue.

LABEL: capillary of spleen
Definition: A capillary that is part of the spleen.

LABEL: bronchial capillary
Definition: A capillary that is part of the bronchial circulation, connecting bronchial arterioles and venules, and supplying the walls of the bronchi with oxygenated blood.

LABEL: buccal mucosa capillary
Definition: A capillary that is part of the buccal mucosa, forming part of the microvascular network that supplies blood to the inner lining of the cheeks and lips.

LABEL: capillary plexus of posterior pituitary gland
Definition: A capillary plexus that forms a dense vascular network in the posterior pituitary gland, receiving secreted neurohypophysial hormones (oxytocin and vasopressin) from axon terminals of hypothalamic neurons for distribution into systemic circulation.

LABEL: parotid gland capillary
Definition: A capillary that is part of the parotid gland, forming part of the microvascular network that supplies blood to the glandular parenchyma and facilitates exchange between blood and the secretory acini.

LABEL: external primary capillary plexus of median eminence
Definition: A capillary plexus that is formed by terminal branches of the superior hypophysial arteries within the median eminence and serves as the primary site where hypothalamic releasing hormones are secreted into the hypophyseal portal circulation before being transported to the anterior pituitary.

LABEL: inferior labial gland capillary
Definition: A capillary that is part of the labial gland and contributes to the microvascular network supplying blood to the secretory and ductal components of the minor salivary gland tissue in the lower lip.

LABEL: internal primary capillary plexus of median eminence
Definition: A capillary plexus located in the internal (deeper) zone of the median eminence, where neurosecretory terminals from hypothalamic neurons release regulatory hormones. This capillary network forms the initial collection point of the hypothalamo-hypophyseal portal system, receiving hypothalamic releasing and inhibiting hormones before they are transported via portal vessels to the anterior pituitary. The internal plexus is distinguished from the external plexus by its deeper position within the median eminence structure and its proximity to the primary neurosecretory terminals.

LABEL: lobular capillary of pancreas
Definition: A capillary that is located within a pancreatic lobule, forming part of the lobular microcirculation that supplies blood to the exocrine acini and islets of Langerhans.

LABEL: dental pulp capillary
Definition: A capillary that is part of the dental pulp and supplies blood to the soft connective tissue within the tooth pulp chamber, connecting arterioles to venules within the neurovascular bundle of the tooth.

LABEL: palatine gland capillary
Definition: A capillary that is part of the vascular network supplying the palatine gland, providing blood flow to the mucous-secreting acini and connective tissue septa of this minor salivary gland located in the soft palate.

LABEL: palatine tonsil capillary
Definition: A capillary that is part of the palatine tonsil.

LABEL: periductal capillary of accessory pancreatic duct
Definition: A capillary that is located adjacent to the accessory pancreatic duct and forms part of the periductal microvascular network that supplies blood to the duct epithelium and surrounding pancreatic tissue.

LABEL: periductal capillary of intercalated duct of pancreas
Definition: A capillary that surrounds and supplies blood to the intercalated duct of the pancreas, forming a perivascular network around the smallest pancreatic ductules where they emerge from acini.

LABEL: periductal capillary of interlobular duct of pancreas
Definition: A capillary that is located adjacent to the interlobular ducts of the exocrine pancreas, forming part of the pancreatic microvascular network that supplies the ductal system.

LABEL: periductal capillary of intralobular duct of pancreas
Definition: A capillary that surrounds and supplies blood to the intralobular ducts within the pancreatic lobule, forming part of the periductal capillary network that supports pancreatic ductal transport.

LABEL: periductal capillary of main pancreatic duct
Definition: A capillary that surrounds the main pancreatic duct, forming part of the periductal microvascular plexus that supplies the ductal epithelium and participates in fluid exchange during pancreatic secretion.

LABEL: post-alveolar capillary
Definition: A capillary that is part of the pulmonary microcirculation and is located downstream of the alveolus, on the venous side of the alveolar-capillary gas exchange unit, where oxygenated blood begins to transition into venules.

LABEL: post-sheath open capillary of spleen
Definition: A capillary of the spleen characterized by lacking an ellipsoid sheath and located distal to sheathed regions in the splenic microcirculation, where blood flows directly into open channels before entering the red pulp sinuses.

LABEL: pre-alveolar capillary
Definition: A pulmonary capillary located in the walls of pre-alveolar airways such as respiratory bronchioles and alveolar ducts, contributing to gas exchange in the respiratory zone proximal to the alveolar sacs.

LABEL: secondary capillary plexus of anterior pituitary gland
Definition: A capillary plexus that forms a network of fenestrated sinusoid capillaries within the anterior pituitary gland, receiving blood from the hypophyseal portal veins that drain the primary capillary plexus of the median eminence, and serving as the site where hypothalamic releasing hormones stimulate or inhibit the secretion of anterior pituitary hormones.

LABEL: sheathed capillary of spleen
Definition: A capillary located within the red pulp of the spleen, characterized by a specialized sheath of reticular cells and fibers surrounding the endothelium that functions in mechanical blood filtration and removal of aged or damaged erythrocytes.

LABEL: sublingual gland capillary
Definition: A capillary that is part of the sublingual gland, forming part of the microvascular network that supplies blood to the secretory acini and ductal structures of this minor salivary gland.

LABEL: submandibular gland capillary
Definition: A capillary that is part of a submandibular gland.

LABEL: superficial white pulp capillary of spleen
Definition: A capillary located in the outer (superficial) region of the white pulp of the spleen, supplying the periarteriolar lymphoid sheath and marginal zone with blood.

LABEL: superior labial gland capillary
Definition: A capillary that is part of a labial gland and contributes to the microvasculature of the upper lip.

LABEL: tongue capillary
Definition: A capillary that is part of the tongue and participates in the microcirculation supplying blood to the tongue tissue, located within the connective tissue and beneath the epithelium.

LABEL: Weber's gland capillary
Definition: A capillary that is part of Weber's gland, the lingual gland located on the lateral margins of the tongue at the level of the foliate papillae.
